notes: Faster logging: the + button now goes straight to typing in calories, with the keyboard ready. Each meal's + does the same for that meal.
Search is back on Today, right under your summary. Type, tap a food and swipe to log. The arrow beside it shows your favourites and recent foods.
Gemini, menu picks and Copy prompt / Paste estimate are under the ✦ button next to search.
Log food now opens with the numbers at the top, so there's nothing to scroll past.
No more flicker when the app starts: it now opens straight in your chosen theme (light, dark or system) instead of flashing light first.
maintenanceNote: Generated by scripts/prebuild.mjs from package.json and src/release-notes.json. Bump the 4-part "version" in package.json by hand (npm version cannot parse it), edit src/release-notes.json, then npm run build.
